{{Quote|Alert! Vergesso asteroid field charts are out of date, and traveling in Lybeya system is considered a Class Three navigation hazard. The system is surveyed, and found to contain no valuable assets.|Lybeya system [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]]|<ref name="SOTEPG" />}}
The '''Lybeya system''' of [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]] was home to five sets of asteroid belts, known as the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]].

==History==
During the primeval formation of the system, some external force, such as the gravitational influence of some other star, disrupted the system's planetary aggregation. As a result, no planetary bodies remained in the system, only five [[Asteroid field/Legends|belts]] of thousands to trillions [[asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] and smaller particles, and only a handful of [[moon/Legends|moon]]-sized planetoids.<ref name="SOTEPG" />

The system was first discovered some centuries before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by a [[Survey droid|scout droid]]. The astrographical location of the system, plus the unworthiness of the asteroids in minerals, made it inconvenient for any colonial, corporate, commercial or strategic/military interest. Around 150 [[standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the curious nature of the asteroid-only system attracted the interest of [[Planetologist/Legends|planetologist]] Dr. [[Ecile Vergesso]]. She came to the [[Vergesso Prime/Legends|the largest planetoid]] in the third belt, and made a survey base to explore the system. Her research earned her tenure, and the asteroids were named after her.<Ref name="SOTEPG" />

Despite, and because of its lack of value, and its remote location, the system attracted criminal activities. Vergesso's installation, was used by [[pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], and a [[shadowport]] for [[Ororo Transportation/Legends|Ororo]], a legal front for [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]] that operated in Bajic and surrounding sectors. Known as the [[Vergesso Base]], it remained the only sentient presence in the system, and the only source of traffic, until it was destroyed in the [[Battle of the Bajic Shipyards]].<Ref name="SOTEPG" />
